segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned over the cabinet, preparing to pick up a building block toy.
The robot arm moves towards the building block toy on the cabinet.
The robot arm grasps the building block toy on the cabinet.
The robot arm lifts the building block toy from the cabinet.
The robot arm moves the building block toy towards the black bowl.
The robot arm places the building block toy into the black bowl.
The robot arm retracts from the black bowl after placing the toy.
The robot arm moves back to the cabinet to pick up another building block toy.
The robot arm grasps another building block toy on the cabinet.
The robot arm lifts the second building block toy from the cabinet.
